key_points: Majority of headlines refer to Red Cat Holdings (RCAT), a drone/defense company, not Caterpillar (CAT) - data contamination
Actual CAT headlines are routine: peer comparisons vs Deere, technical/options analysis, general forecasts
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, M&A, regulatory events, or major product/management news for Caterpillar
Pure noise for long-term thesis; any price effect would be very short-term technical trading
Investor should ignore Red Cat headlines entirely and treat CAT coverage as background noise
